LESSON: DUA (SUPPLICATION S) DUA ON INCREASE IN KNOWLEDGE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.5: Dua (Supplication s) Dua On Increase In Knowledge

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Dua (Supplication s) Dua On Increase In Knowledge. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is the importance of reciting dua always?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recite the selected dua to attain beneficial knowledge
2. apply the dua in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recite the selected dua to attain beneficial knowledge
   In simple words: practise until you can recite the selected dua to attain beneficial knowledge. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. apply the dua in day-to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can apply the dua in day-to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Dua (Supplication s) Dua On Increase In Knowledge using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Dua (Supplication s) Dua On Increase In Knowledge in the examples.
2. Explain Dua (Supplication s) Dua On Increase In Knowledge to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dua (Supplication s) Dua On Increase In Knowledge.
4. Show that you can: recite the selected dua to attain beneficial knowledge

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dua (Supplication s) Dua On Increase In Knowledge using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Dua (Supplication s) Dua On Increase In Knowledge important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen and recite the following dua from a digital device/teacher, “Oh Allah make what you teach me beneficial, teach me what is beneficial, and increase me in knowledge”,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recite the selected dua to attain beneficial knowledge
2. apply the dua in day-to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
